collection_window.note: Corpus collected on/before 2026-07-19; predates the 2026-07-28 MCP spec revision. Re-measure scheduled for 2026-08-11.

reproducible_subset.note: Only the registry corpus is committed to git; the crawl configs are gitignored and not redistributed, so full-corpus numbers are not independently re-scannable — the registry subset is.

false_positive_rate.benign_slice_predicate: official MCP Registry latest-version server AND status=active AND auth_mode in {static-credential, header-nonsecret, local-stdio} AND not in AAK's shipped CVE/advisory feed (vuln_db.json + CVE-pin package names)

hand_adjudication.note: Single rater; ambiguous counts in the denominator, not as an FP. Both FPs share one root cause (AAK-MCP-001 not recognising custom API-key headers). See benchmarks/false_positive/triage.md.
